title: Severe Bleeding
immediate_warning: Act fast. Severe bleeding can be fatal within minutes.

immediate_warning_translations.en: Act fast. Severe bleeding can be fatal within minutes.
immediate_warning_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Act fast. Severe bleeding can be fatal within minutes.
immediate_warning_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Act fast. Severe bleeding can be fatal within minutes.
immediate_warning_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Act fast. Severe bleeding can be fatal within minutes.
immediate_warning_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Act fast. Severe bleeding can be fatal within minutes.

description: Severe bleeding happens when a major blood vessel is cut or torn.

description_translations.en: Severe bleeding happens when a major blood vessel is cut or torn.
description_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Severe bleeding happens when a major blood vessel is cut or torn.
description_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Severe bleeding happens when a major blood vessel is cut or torn.
description_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Severe bleeding happens when a major blood vessel is cut or torn.
description_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Severe bleeding happens when a major blood vessel is cut or torn.

steps.instruction: Find the source of the bleeding and apply direct, firm pressure to the wound with a clean cloth or your hands.

instruction_translations.en: Find the source of the bleeding and apply direct, firm pressure to the wound with a clean cloth or your hands.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Find the source of the bleeding and apply direct, firm pressure to the wound with a clean cloth or your hands.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Find the source of the bleeding and apply direct, firm pressure to the wound with a clean cloth or your hands.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Find the source of the bleeding and apply direct, firm pressure to the wound with a clean cloth or your hands.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Find the source of the bleeding and apply direct, firm pressure to the wound with a clean cloth or your hands.

steps.instruction: If the bleeding is on an arm or leg, elevate the limb above the heart if possible.

instruction_translations.en: If the bleeding is on an arm or leg, elevate the limb above the heart if possible.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the bleeding is on an arm or leg, elevate the limb above the heart if possible.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the bleeding is on an arm or leg, elevate the limb above the heart if possible.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the bleeding is on an arm or leg, elevate the limb above the heart if possible.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the bleeding is on an arm or leg, elevate the limb above the heart if possible.

steps.instruction: Do not remove the cloth. If blood soaks through, put another cloth on top and keep pressing.

instruction_translations.en: Do not remove the cloth. If blood soaks through, put another cloth on top and keep pressing.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Do not remove the cloth. If blood soaks through, put another cloth on top and keep pressing.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Do not remove the cloth. If blood soaks through, put another cloth on top and keep pressing.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Do not remove the cloth. If blood soaks through, put another cloth on top and keep pressing.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Do not remove the cloth. If blood soaks through, put another cloth on top and keep pressing.

steps.instruction: Keep pressure continuous for at least 10 minutes without checking the wound.

instruction_translations.en: Keep pressure continuous for at least 10 minutes without checking the wound.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Keep pressure continuous for at least 10 minutes without checking the wound.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Keep pressure continuous for at least 10 minutes without checking the wound.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Keep pressure continuous for at least 10 minutes without checking the wound.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Keep pressure continuous for at least 10 minutes without checking the wound.

steps.instruction: If the bleeding does not stop with direct pressure, apply a tourniquet 2 to 3 inches above the wound.

instruction_translations.en: If the bleeding does not stop with direct pressure, apply a tourniquet 2 to 3 inches above the wound.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the bleeding does not stop with direct pressure, apply a tourniquet 2 to 3 inches above the wound.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the bleeding does not stop with direct pressure, apply a tourniquet 2 to 3 inches above the wound.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the bleeding does not stop with direct pressure, apply a tourniquet 2 to 3 inches above the wound.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the bleeding does not stop with direct pressure, apply a tourniquet 2 to 3 inches above the wound.

do_not: Do not remove the original cloth or bandage.
Do not apply a tourniquet over a joint.
